about: docs/246: the hands-on checklist (docs/105) as steps the AI runs through MCP. Each item: a new document, the 'base' steps, its own steps; 'expect' is what the AI checks (contains / not_contains in the answer and, for render_drawing_set with texts, the sheet's words; fails: the tool must refuse); 'picture' keeps the answer's picture in the report; 'look' is what only the owner can judge.
